content.stem: 对于那些想通过会计师或会计事务所洗钱的人来说，会计师的哪项特质最具吸引力？

options.A: 会计人员可以编制账簿和电子表格，起草年度报表并向政府部门付款
options.B: 会计师能够就公司的架构提供咨询，并确保符合当地的税收法规
options.C: 会计人员精通财务管理，包括在会计年度内应记录的内容
options.D: 会计师能够创建和组建公司、伪造账目以及操纵财务报表

content.stem_en: Which characteristic of accountants is most attractive to those looking to launder funds using an accountant or accountancy firm?

options_en.A: Accountants can prepare ledgers and spreadsheets, draft annual returns and make payments to government offices
options_en.B: Accountants can advise on the structuring of companies as well as ensure compliance with local tax regulations
options_en.C: Accountants are knowledgeable about financial management, including what to record over the course of the accounting year
options_en.D: Accountants are able to create and structure companies, falsify accounts and manipulate financial statements
